cards.example_en: Courage is the theme running through this novel.
cards.example_zh: 勇气是贯穿这本小说的主题。

cards.example_en: The experiment supports the theory.
cards.example_zh: 实验支持这个理论。

cards.example_en: Slow thinking saved him from a careless mistake.
cards.example_zh: 慢慢思考让他避免了一个粗心的错误。

cards.example_en: Do a thorough check before you leave.
cards.example_zh: 离开前做一次彻底检查。

cards.example_en: Floodwater became a threat to houses by the river.
cards.example_zh: 洪水成了河边那些房子的威胁。

cards.example_en: The heavy rain may threaten the riverside football pitch.
cards.example_zh: 大雨可能会威胁到河边的足球场。

cards.example_en: Snow fell throughout the night and covered the playground.
cards.example_zh: 雪下了整整一夜，把操场都盖住了。

cards.example_en: He studied hard; thus he passed.
cards.example_zh: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。

cards.example_en: These football shoes feel tight around my toes.
cards.example_zh: 这双足球鞋把我的脚趾夹得很紧。

cards.example_en: I left a tip because the waiter had been kind.
cards.example_zh: 服务员一直很热情，所以我留了小费。

cards.example_en: She used a tissue to wipe the desk.
cards.example_zh: 她用纸巾擦桌子。

cards.example_en: What is the title of this book?
cards.example_zh: 这本书的标题是什么？

cards.example_en: The toast popped up burnt, so I scraped it.
cards.example_zh: 吐司弹起来已经糊了，我把糊的地方刮掉。

cards.example_en: The shop does not sell tobacco to students.
cards.example_zh: 这家店不向学生出售烟草。

cards.example_en: I cannot tolerate loud noise when I study.
cards.example_zh: 学习时我无法忍受大噪音。

cards.example_en: Do not use a rude tone when you ask for help.
cards.example_zh: 向别人求助的时候，不要用粗鲁的语气。

cards.example_en: He went to the dentist with a toothache.
cards.example_zh: 他牙疼去看了牙医。

cards.example_en: Our topic for the debate is phones in school.
cards.example_zh: 我们这场辩论的话题是学校里能不能用手机。

cards.example_en: The last science problem was tough for everyone.
cards.example_zh: 最后一道科学题大家都觉得很难。

cards.example_en: Our school won the basketball tournament.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校赢了篮球锦标赛。

cards.example_en: Bring a towel for swimming.
cards.example_zh: 游泳带一条毛巾。

cards.example_en: Stay in your lane when you run on the track.
cards.example_zh: 在跑道上跑的时候，要待在自己的赛道里。

cards.example_en: We had a traditional meal at New Year.
cards.example_zh: 我们在新年吃了一顿传统的饭菜。

cards.example_en: Colours and lights can transform the hall for the dance.
cards.example_zh: 色彩和灯光能把礼堂转变成舞会场地。

cards.example_en: Our town uses river transport to bring rice to the market.
cards.example_zh: 我们镇用河道运输把大米送到市场。

cards.example_en: The question was a trap for careless readers.
cards.example_zh: 这道题是给粗心读者设的陷阱。

cards.example_en: Kind treatment from the coach made the new player relax.
cards.example_zh: 教练的善意对待让那位新队员放松了下来。

cards.example_en: Short videos became a trend among students this year.
cards.example_zh: 短视频今年在学生中间成了一种潮流。

cards.example_en: The bike theft trial lasted two days in the city court.
cards.example_zh: 这起自行车盗窃案的审讯在市法院持续了两天。

cards.example_en: The magician showed a simple trick.
cards.example_zh: 魔术师表演了一个简单的戏法。

cards.example_en: A bird sat on the trunk of the tree.
cards.example_zh: 一只鸟停在树干上。

cards.example_en: Toothpaste squeezed from the tube fell onto my brush.
cards.example_zh: 牙膏从管子里挤出来，掉到了我的牙刷上。

cards.example_en: Grandpa hummed an old tune while washing the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷洗碗的时候哼着一首老调子。

cards.example_en: My cousin sent a postcard from Turkey during the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 假期里，表哥从土耳其寄来了一张明信片。

cards.example_en: I have been there twice.
cards.example_zh: 我去过那里两次。

cards.example_en: My twin brother is ten minutes older than me.
cards.example_zh: 我的双胞胎哥哥比我大十分钟。

cards.example_en: This type of bread stays fresh for two days.
cards.example_zh: 这种类型的面包可以保鲜两天。

cards.example_en: The typhoon closed the school for a day.
cards.example_zh: 台风让学校停课一天。

cards.example_en: A typical breakfast at our school is rice and eggs.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校典型的早餐是米饭和鸡蛋。

cards.example_en: Ultimately, practice decides the result.
cards.example_zh: 最终，练习决定结果。

cards.example_en: Each student is unique.
cards.example_zh: 每个学生都是独特的。

cards.example_en: An unusual bird landed on our balcony this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，一只少见的鸟落在我们的阳台上。

cards.example_en: Parents update phone numbers on the class contact list.
cards.example_zh: 家长在班级联系名单上更新电话号码。

cards.example_en: The upper line of the form is for your class number.
cards.example_zh: 表格上面的一行是填班级号的。

cards.example_en: The cat may upset the milk bowl on the kitchen table.
cards.example_zh: 猫可能会打翻厨房桌上的牛奶碗。

cards.example_en: Urban life can be fast and noisy.
cards.example_zh: 城市生活可能又快又吵。

cards.example_en: Teachers urge students to read every day.
cards.example_zh: 老师敦促学生每天阅读。

cards.example_en: This is an urgent message.
cards.example_zh: 这是一条紧急消息。

cards.example_en: I bought a used bike at the weekend market.
cards.example_zh: 我在周末市场买了一辆二手自行车。

cards.example_en: A map is useful when we visit a new city.
cards.example_zh: 去一座新城市的时候，地图很有用。

word.example_en: I am used to getting up early.
A map is useful to visitors.
